description: Return the Sovereign Logos daily reading for a date. The default date is today in the given timezone. The response contains post text (a "Good Morning" line, the CHRIST IS KING reading summary, and the reading page URL), the four readings from the one-year plan, and URLs for two branded card images (feed 1080x1350 PNG and story 1080x1920 PNG). Each card image includes the Sovereign Logos QR code. This tool returns that data and does not post it anywhere.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used to decide "today" when date is omitted, e.g. America/Chicago. Default UTC, matching sovereignlogos.com/read/today.

name: get_daily_post
title: Get daily post
